001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats events as <a href="http://ltsv.org">LTSV</a> (Labeled Tab-separated
009 * Values), one line of tab separated <code>label:value</code> fields per event,
010 * selected with the ltsv encoder scheme.
011 * <p>
012 * Each event is written as one line, for example (<code>⇥</code> is a tab):
013 * <code>time:2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥level:INFO⇥logger:com.example.App⇥threadId:1⇥threadName:main⇥message:hello world⇥requestId:42</code>
014 * <ul>
015 * <li>The labels are logfmt's field names. The thread fields are chosen with
016 * {@link ThreadFields}, by default <code>threadId</code> and
017 * <code>threadName</code>.</li>
018 * <li>The fields listed as columns (see {@link EventField}) come first, in the order
019 * listed and without labels, so they are read by position. With
020 * <code>columns=time,level,logger,thread,message</code>:
021 * <code>2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥INFO⇥com.example.App⇥1⇥main⇥hello world⇥requestId:42</code>.
022 * The fields not listed follow with their labels, before the key values. With
023 * <code>columns=thread,message</code>:
024 * <code>1⇥main⇥hello world⇥time:2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥level:INFO⇥logger:com.example.App⇥requestId:42</code>.
025 * Output with columns is no longer LTSV.</li>
026 * <li><code>time</code> is the UTC instant with milliseconds by default, and the
027 * <code>time</code> property chooses another format or a DateTimeFormatter pattern in
028 * UTC, as for TTLL.</li>
029 * <li><code>level</code> is <code>TRACE</code>, <code>DEBUG</code>,
030 * <code>INFO</code>, <code>WARN</code>, or <code>ERROR</code>, unpadded by
031 * default.</li>
032 * <li>A field set to <code>none</code> is not written, and cannot be a column.</li>
033 * <li>The key values follow the fields, in order. A key value named like one of these
034 * fields is prefixed with <code>keyValues.</code>. A key value without a value is
035 * written with an empty one.</li>
036 * <li>A throwable adds <code>error</code> (its <code>toString()</code>) and
037 * <code>stacktrace</code>, last on the line. With <code>stacktrace=lines</code> each
038 * line of the stack trace follows the event's line on a line of its own, after a tab,
039 * see {@link LtsvStackTrace#LINES}. In this mode an empty first positional column is
040 * written as <code>\e</code>, so an event never starts with a tab.</li>
041 * </ul>
042 * <strong>Value escaping.</strong> Values are never quoted. The same escaping applies
043 * to messages, metadata, key values, and throwable text:
044 * <table class="table">
045 * <caption><strong>LTSV value escapes</strong></caption>
046 * <tr>
047 * <th scope="col">Input</th>
048 * <th scope="col">Written text</th>
049 * </tr>
050 * <tr>
051 * <td>Backslash</td>
052 * <td><code>\\</code></td>
053 * </tr>
054 * <tr>
055 * <td>Tab, LF, CR</td>
056 * <td><code>\t</code>, <code>\n</code>, <code>\r</code></td>
057 * </tr>
058 * <tr>
059 * <td>
060 * <ul>
061 * <li>Other C0 controls (U+0000–U+001F)</li>
062 * <li>DEL and C1 (U+007F–U+009F)</li>
063 * <li>U+2028/U+2029</li>
064 * <li>Unicode format characters (category Cf)</li>
065 * <li>Unpaired UTF-16 surrogates</li>
066 * </ul>
067 * </td>
068 * <td><code>&#92;uXXXX</code>, four lowercase hexadecimal digits per UTF-16 code
069 * unit</td>
070 * </tr>
071 * </table>
072 * This covers the Unicode 17 format characters even on Java 21, including bidi
073 * controls. A supplementary format character becomes two surrogate escapes. Other
074 * valid Unicode text is preserved without normalization, including ordinary
075 * supplementary characters. Quotes, colons, and percent signs in values are
076 * unchanged. Every ESC (U+001B) and C1 control from input is escaped, including SGR
077 * sequences that could hide or restyle text. An actual newline becomes
078 * <code>\n</code>; a literal backslash followed by n becomes <code>\\n</code>.
079 * <p>
080 * <strong>Label encoding.</strong> Labels preserve <code>A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -</code>.
081 * Other valid Unicode is encoded as UTF-8 bytes, each written as <code>%HH</code>
082 * with uppercase hexadecimal digits: <code>a b</code> becomes <code>a%20b</code>,
083 * <code>:</code> becomes <code>%3A</code>, and a literal <code>%</code> becomes
084 * <code>%25</code>. An empty key becomes a lone <code>%</code>. An unpaired surrogate
085 * uses the extension <code>%uXXXX</code> with four uppercase hexadecimal digits (for
086 * example <code>%uD800</code>), preserving malformed input without collisions. A
087 * literal <code>%uD800</code> becomes <code>%25uD800</code>. Keys starting with
088 * <code>keyValues.</code> also receive that prefix, keeping application keys distinct
089 * from prefixed built-in field names.
090 * <p>
091 * <strong>Reading records.</strong> For machine parsing, use <code>color=off</code>
092 * and leave <code>columns</code> empty. Split at raw LF and tabs, then split each
093 * labeled field at its first colon. Decode value backslash escapes once, after
094 * splitting; recursive decoding would turn literal escape text into controls. Decode
095 * label percent bytes as UTF-8, handling the empty-key sentinel and surrogate
096 * extension separately. These are this formatter's encoding conventions layered on
097 * LTSV; generic LTSV readers need them to recover the original text. Escaping a value
098 * takes linear time and space in its input length; this formatter does not impose a
099 * record or value length limit.
100 * <p>
101 * Values can be colored like the TTLL formatter; built-in labels and
102 * <code>message</code> are not. Key-value labels and values are colored together.
103 * <code>error</code> and <code>stacktrace</code> take the level's color, since they
104 * are on the event's line. These formatter-owned colors are added outside value
105 * escaping; escape characters supplied in field values are always escaped. Select
106 * <code>color=off</code> to suppress formatter-owned ANSI sequences as well.
107 * <table class="table">
108 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
109 * <tr>
110 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
111 * <th>Type</th>
112 * <th>Required</th>
113 * <th>Default</th>
114 * <th>Description</th>
115 * </tr>
116 * <tr>
117 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.time" }</code></td>
118 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
119 * <td><code>true</code></td>
120 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.TimestampFormat#ISO iso}</td>
121 * <td>Time format, see {@link TTLL.TimestampFormat}; <code>default</code> is <code>iso</code>.</td>
122 * </tr>
123 * <tr>
124 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.thread" }</code></td>
125 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
126 * <td><code>true</code></td>
127 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}</td>
128 * <td>Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.</td>
129 * </tr>
130 * <tr>
131 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.level" }</code></td>
132 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
133 * <td><code>true</code></td>
134 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LevelFormat#PLAIN plain}</td>
135 * <td>Level format, see {@link TTLL.LevelFormat}; <code>default</code> is <code>plain</code>.</td>
136 * </tr>
137 * <tr>
138 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.logger" }</code></td>
139 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
140 * <td><code>true</code></td>
141 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LoggerFormat#FULL full}</td>
142 * <td>Logger name format, see {@link TTLL.LoggerFormat}.</td>
143 * </tr>
144 * <tr>
145 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.columns" }</code></td>
146 * <td><code>{@link LogProperties#listOrNull(String) List&lt;String&gt;}</code></td>
147 * <td><code>true</code></td>
148 * <td>none, so every field is labeled</td>
149 * <td>The fields written first without labels, see {@link EventField}.</td>
150 * </tr>
151 * <tr>
152 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.stacktrace" }</code></td>
153 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
154 * <td><code>true</code></td>
155 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvStackTrace#INLINE inline}</td>
156 * <td>How a stack trace is written, see {@link LtsvStackTrace}.</td>
157 * </tr>
158 * <tr>
159 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.color" }</code></td>
160 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
161 * <td><code>false</code></td>
162 * <td><code>null</code></td>
163 * <td>Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
164 * </tr>
165 * <tr>
166 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.theme" }</code></td>
167 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
168 * <td><code>false</code></td>
169 * <td><code>null</code></td>
170 * <td>Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
171 * </tr>
172 * </table>
173 */
174public final class LtsvFormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<LtsvFormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {

236        /**
237         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
238         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
239         */
240        public LtsvFormatterBuilder(
241                        java.lang.String name
242                        ) {
243                try {
244                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
245                                        "name", name
246                                );
247                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
248                        this.name = name;
249                        property_time = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_time, prefixParameters);
250                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
251                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
252                        property_logger = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_logger, prefixParameters);
253                        property_columns = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_columns, prefixParameters);
254                        property_stacktrace = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_stacktrace, prefixParameters);
255                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
256                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
257                }
258                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
259                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
260                }
261        }

397        @Override
398        public LtsvFormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
399                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
400                var _time = properties.forKey(property_time).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertTimestamp(_v)).or(this.time).validate(__v);
401                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
402                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
403                var _logger = properties.forKey(property_logger).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertLogger(_v)).or(this.logger).validate(__v);
404                var _columns = properties.forKey(property_columns).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertColumns(_v)).or(this.columns).validate(__v);
405                var _stacktrace = properties.forKey(property_stacktrace).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertStacktrace(_v)).or(this.stacktrace).validate(__v);
406                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
407                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
408                __v.validate();
409                this.time = _time.value();
410                this.thread = _thread.value();
411                this.level = _level.value();
412                this.logger = _logger.value();
413                this.columns = _columns.value();
414                this.stacktrace = _stacktrace.value();
415                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
416                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
417                return this;
418        }
